lines: Spurred on by the roar of the animals behind us, we were sprinting toward the top of the mountain.
After all, it wasn't just normal animals that were chasing us. It was bears and snakes with Taimanin abilities, very dangerous animals.
My cuties... Have you forgotten about me...?
Didn't you say they were friendly when you're around!?
Sakura-sensei nodded her head while crying softly. She appeared quite shocked to be attacked by the supposedly friendly animals.
They've completely returned to being wild animals though!!!? Hebiko hopes Shikanosuke-chan is alright...
But listen everybody! There's something wrong with them!
They're back to being wild animals and attacking people. In a way that's normal...
That's not what I mean!! It feels like they're being manipulated somehow...
Anyway, let's talk after Heberybody has lost them!!
We should be close to the castle ruins!
Speaking of castle ruins... wasn't there only a single stone monument left standing?
There should be... All of this wasn't here before... Sakura-sensei saw it too.
For a few moments, we just stared blankly at the unbelievable scenery.
In front of us was a magnificent castle gate and a path leading inside.
Does that means those rumors were true?
Amazing!!! It's a mystery!!! A haunted castle!!!
That's ridiculous. There's got to be some kind of trick...
Let's head inside for now! Hebiko doesn't want to get caught by those friendly animals!
There was no time for hesitation. We rushed through the castle gate and... an ominous creaking could be heard from behind us.
When we turned around, the gate was closed.
They seem to be welcoming Heberybody...
The plot thickens!!! I'll be able to boast to onee-chan!!!
For now we had no choice but to keep going. On high alert, we stepped forwardー
Someone leapt out of the darkness.
